newsitem.title: JAPAN: Matsushita Comm mulls builiding research lab.
newsitem.headline: Matsushita Comm mulls builiding research lab.

text.p: Matsushita Communication Industrial Co Ltd said on Thursday it is considering building a research laboratory for mobile communications in southern Tokyo.

The business daily Nihon Keizai Shimbun reported on Thursday that the company plans to build an eight billion yen research lab for studying such subjects as an international standard for cellular phones and mobile terminal for transmitting pictures.
The paper also said that the construction of the lab is expected to be completed in early 1998.
However, a company spokesman said that such details about the lab have not been decided.
The company, which makes mobile communications and car audio equipment, is a subsidiary of Matsushita Electric Industrial Co Ltd.
